The interview also examines the emerging role of AI agents in consumer interactions. Additional topics include the importance of authentic customer relationships, the role of trusted advocates and creators, the effective use of AI tools, and the need for high-quality data and context when deploying AI-powered systems. Throughout the discussion, the founders provide perspective on how businesses can adapt marketing, customer engagement, and brand-building strategies to meet the demands of an increasingly AI-driven future.
